p3_b2.ocr: The production cost per tonne serves as a pivotal metric, influencing both operational efficiency and overall profitability. p3_b3.ocr: In contrast, the open-pit operation, which reported a production cost of £100M, is often characterized by its scalability and lower operational costs.
